fixed_endpoint.cover_text: In a small bowl, combine fennel, capers, grapefruit juice, and cinnamon. Stir. Shred seeds and spices into veggie broth. Cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until liquid has evaporated. Pour August Cream Cheese on top of the peppermint peppercorns. Turn head to 3" towards midguard, and out medium sized sinews, making sure about halfway down the middle, to place the bread in the center. It should have already gone into ball form with the base raised to the desired dish height. Spoon on desired meat, and nice cheese, and serve lickety-nail!
